description: A wide brick front with a run of clerestory glazing high up under the eaves, because a saleroom is lit from above or it is not lit at all. At street level there is one ordinary door for people and, beside it, a goods door wide enough and high enough to take a piano upright, with a rail let into the stone at ankle height where trolleys have been running into it for years. 8 HALCYON BOULEVARD is painted straight onto the brick in a serif two feet tall, and under it, in half the size: VALUATIONS · CLEARANCES · WEDNESDAYS.
name: 8 Halcyon Boulevard
